'''Cancelled Virtual Sets''' are [[Players Committee]] Virtual products that were planned or listed but '''not''' released in the form described &mdash; as opposed to [[Cancelled Expansions]], which covers '''Decipher''' expansions announced after [[Death Star II]] and never published.

This hub keeps virtual cancellations out of [[:Category:Cancelled sets]] (Decipher-only on this wiki). For Decipher cancelled product, see [[Cancelled Expansions]].

== [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]] (unreleased / cancelled) ==

A Polish fan overview of Star Wars CCG Virtual Sets lists, under previous virtual expansions:

* '''[[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]]''' (''niewydany'') &mdash; Polish ''niewydany'' = '''unreleased'''.<ref name="pl-vs">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG &mdash; Virtual Sets], Bastion Polskich Fan&oacute;w Star Wars (star-wars.pl)</ref>

On that Polish page, '''only one''' entry is marked ''(niewydany)''. That sole marked item is Original-era '''[[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]]''' (star-wars.pl orthography: Galaxy at War). Status on this wiki: '''planned Original-era Virtual Set 19, unreleased''' per the Polish list. No primary starwarsccg.org &ldquo;Galaxy at War cancelled&rdquo; announce was recovered beyond that Polish marking.

=== Naming collision: modern Virtual Set 19 ===

The modern set titled [[Virtual Set 19]] (Players Committee Current Virtual / Rebels-themed product, announced August 2022)<ref name="vs19-modern">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived/ The Beautiful and Thematic Virtual Set 19 Has Arrived], starwarsccg.org</ref> is a '''different product''' from the Original-era '''[[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|Galaxy At War]]''' plan. Do not merge the two.

== Original VS18 / Fifth Anthology (naming &amp; PDF note &mdash; not a full cancel) ==

'''Do not treat Fifth Anthology like Galaxy at War.''' It is '''not''' the Polish ''(niewydany)'' row.

* '''Previewed''' as Original-era '''Virtual Set 18: Fifth Anthology''' (Polish preview '''8 June 2009'''; planned July 2009 premiere), with six cards marked '''Virtual Set 18'''.<ref name="pl-fifth">[https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Preview Fifth Anthology], star-wars.pl, 8 June 2009</ref>
* '''No standalone set PDF:''' [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards18.pdf VirtualCards18.pdf] returns '''HTTP 403''' on the PC CDN (VirtualCards17.pdf is present). Players Committee [[V-slips|virtual-slips]] Legacy Virtual Sets still list '''VS1&ndash;VS17 only'''.<ref name="vslips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="vc17">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks</ref>
* '''Released via Reflections IV:''' The same preview '''titles''' appear under '''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''' / later [[Virtual Block 6]] (PDF official text '''4 September 2009'''; cardlist [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html VBlock6.html]). Spot-checks of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] show '''Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force''' (#67) and '''Maneuvering Flaps &amp; Nick Of Time''' (#81) gametext matching the June preview.<ref name="vb6pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] (Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV; official text as of 4 September 2009)</ref><ref name="vb6list">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html Virtual Block 6 cardlist], res.starwarsccg.org</ref>
* Polish inventory lists Fifth Anthology '''without''' ''(niewydany)''.<ref name="pl-vs" />
* Block intros count &ldquo;previous '''18''' virtual sets&rdquo; even without a hosted VirtualCards18.pdf.<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009)</ref>
* The [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] (25 July 2014) is '''unrelated''' (~5 years later) and does '''not''' explain the missing VS18 PDF.
* Modern [[Virtual Set 18]] (released '''21 April 2022''') is a '''different''' Current Virtual product &mdash; not Fifth Anthology.

'''Framing:''' previewed as VS18 / '''no''' standalone VirtualCards18.pdf / '''folded into Reflections IV''' (Virtual Set 6 &rarr; Virtual Block 6). Full narrative: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] and [[Virtual Block 6]].

== V-set / Virtual Block 9.2 ==

Related (but '''not''' a second Polish ''niewydany'' Virtual Set row, and '''not''' Galaxy at War): Virtual Block / V-set '''9.2'''.

* Players Committee virtual-slips still lists Legacy Blocks including '''9.1''' and '''9.2'''. VB '''9.1''' (''Republic at War'') shipped '''10 January 2014'''. Listing of '''9.2''' on virtual-slips is '''not''' by itself proof that 9.2 shipped as a full released set.<ref name="vslips" />
* Official PC announce '''Reset of Standard Format''' ([https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ live]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Wayback 6 Mar 2017]; byline '''July 25th, 2014''') states: &ldquo;'''9.2 will not be released in its current form.''' We are planning on releasing a mini, 12 card set for Worlds&hellip;&rdquo;<ref name="reset-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format] (live) &mdash; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Wayback, 6 Mar 2017]; byline darkjediknight11, July 25th, 2014</ref> That wording is about '''VB/V-set 9.2''', '''not''' about Original-era Virtual Set 19: Galaxy at War, and '''not''' about Fifth Anthology. Do not equate 9.2 with Galaxy at War.

This wiki does '''not''' claim that VB/V-set 9.2 was fully released. Exact fate/title of any Worlds &ldquo;mini ~12-card&rdquo; product vs the virtual-slips &ldquo;9.2&rdquo; listing remains an open gap. Full Reset context: [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]].
